++apps.start_page.sub_header="Together, these apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.
"

As you work through your list and check off completed tasks, you'll feel a satisfying sense of progress that keeps you motivated. Breaking down big projects into smaller, actionable steps makes even the most daunting goals feel achievable. By keeping your calendar up to date, you'll feel more in control of your schedule and better prepared to handle whatever comes your way. For example, schedule time to browse for gifts.
",icon:"/assets/icons/real_icons/calendar.png",enabled:true,position:2,clickable_logo:false},messages:{title:"OpenMessages",description:"An instant messenger is a digital communication tool that allows you to send and receive messages in real time. Instant messengers are designed for convenience and speed, letting you have quick conversations or ongoing discussions without the delays of email or traditional mail. Many services also offer features like message notifications, read receipts, and the ability to see when someone is online or typing. ++apps.start_page.sub_header="Together, these apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.
"

++apps.start_page.apps={todo:{title:"OpenTodos",description:"A to-do list is your personal assistant for staying organized and on top of your daily tasks. By jotting down everything you need to accomplish, you create a clear roadmap for your day, helping you prioritize what's most important and ensuring nothing slips through the cracks. Whether you prefer using a notebook, a digital app, or sticky notes, a to-do list adapts to your style and keeps your responsibilities visible and manageable. As you work through your list and check off completed tasks, you'll feel a satisfying sense of progress that keeps you motivated. Breaking down big projects into smaller, actionable steps makes even the most daunting goals feel achievable. ++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.
",button_title:"Don't care, let's start",position:"top right",url_extension:"",link_button_title:"Let us be careful more information",link_button_url:"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_Data_Protection_Regulation",image_url:null}}

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Willkommen bei den OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.start_page.sub_header="Together, these apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.
"

++apps.start_page.apps={todo:{title:"OpenTodos",description:"A to-do list is your personal assistant for staying organized and on top of your daily tasks. By jotting down everything you need to accomplish, you create a clear roadmap for your day, helping you prioritize what's most important and ensuring nothing slips through the cracks. Whether you prefer using a notebook, a digital app, or sticky notes, a to-do list adapts to your style and keeps your responsibilities visible and manageable. As you work through your list and check off completed tasks, you'll feel a satisfying sense of progress that keeps you motivated. Breaking down big projects into smaller, actionable steps makes even the most daunting goals feel achievable. With a to-do list by your side, you'll find it easier to stay focused, reduce stress, and make the most of your time—so you can accomplish more with confidence. For example, add a reminder to send someone a message.
",icon:"/assets/icons/real_icons/todo.png",enabled:true,position:1,clickable_logo:false},calendar:{title:"OpenCalendar",description:"A calendar is an essential tool for managing your time and staying organized. By using a calendar, you can schedule important events, appointments, and deadlines, ensuring you never miss a meeting or forget a special occasion. Whether you choose a traditional paper calendar, a wall planner, or a digital calendar app, this tool helps you visualize your days, weeks, and months at a glance. With a calendar, you can plan ahead, set reminders, and allocate time for both work and personal activities. It allows you to balance your commitments, avoid scheduling conflicts, and make the most of your available time. By keeping your calendar up to date, you'll feel more in control of your schedule and better prepared to handle whatever comes your way. For example, schedule time to browse for gifts.
",icon:"/assets/icons/real_icons/calendar.png",enabled:true,position:2,clickable_logo:false},messages:{title:"OpenMessages",description:"An instant messenger is a digital communication tool that allows you to send and receive messages in real time. With an instant messenger, you can chat with friends, family, or colleagues instantly, whether you're using a computer, tablet, or smartphone. These platforms often support not just text messages, but also voice and video calls, file sharing, emojis, and group chats, making it easy to stay connected and collaborate from anywhere. Instant messengers are designed for convenience and speed, letting you have quick conversations or ongoing discussions without the delays of email or traditional mail. Many services also offer features like message notifications, read receipts, and the ability to see when someone is online or typing. By using an instant messenger, you can keep your conversations organized, respond promptly, and maintain strong connections with the people who matter most to you. For example, send a friend your location.
",icon:"/assets/icons/real_icons/messages.png",user_icon:"/assets/icons/real_icons_bw/user.png",group_icon:"/assets/icons/real_icons_bw/group.png",enabled:true,position:3,clickable_logo:false},maps:{title:"OpenMaps",description:"A map service is a digital tool that helps you navigate the world around you with ease. By using a map service, you can find directions to your destination, explore new areas, and discover points of interest such as restaurants, gas stations, or landmarks. Whether you're planning a road trip, commuting to work, or simply exploring your neighborhood, a map service provides real-time information to guide your journey. Most map services offer features like turn-by-turn navigation, traffic updates, and estimated travel times, making it easier to plan your route and avoid delays. You can also use them to view different types of maps, such as satellite imagery or street views, for a more detailed understanding of your surroundings. With a map service at your fingertips, you'll feel confident finding your way, no matter where you are. For example, look up directions to a store.
",icon:"/assets/icons/real_icons/maps.png",enabled:true,position:4,clickable_logo:false},codeeditor:{title:"OpenCodeEditor",description:"A code editor is a specialized software tool designed to help you write, edit, and manage computer code efficiently. Whether you're a beginner learning your first programming language or an experienced developer working on complex projects, a code editor provides features that make coding easier and more productive. These features often include syntax highlighting, auto-completion, and error detection, which help you spot mistakes and write cleaner code. Many code editors also support extensions and integrations, allowing you to customize your workspace and connect with other development tools, such as version control systems or debuggers. With a code editor, you can organize your files, navigate large codebases, and streamline your workflow. By using a code editor tailored to your needs, you'll be able to focus on building great software and bring your ideas to life more efficiently. For example, write a script to automate adding events to OpenCalendar.
",icon:"/assets/icons/real_icons/code.png",enabled:true,position:5,clickable_logo:false},onlineshop:{title:"OpenShop",description:"An online shop is a digital platform where you can browse, select, and purchase products or services from the comfort of your own home. With an online shop, you have access to a wide variety of items—from clothing and electronics to groceries and gifts—often with detailed descriptions, customer reviews, and images to help you make informed choices. Shopping online saves you time and effort, allowing you to compare prices, find deals, and place orders at any time that suits you. Most online shops offer secure payment options and convenient delivery services, so your purchases are shipped directly to your doorstep. Many platforms also provide features like wish lists, order tracking, and easy returns, making the shopping experience smooth and user-friendly. By using an online shop, you can enjoy a flexible, efficient, and personalized way to meet your shopping needs, all without leaving your home. For example, purchase a new laptop to use for coding.
",icon:"/assets/icons/real_icons/shop.png",enabled:true,position:6,clickable_logo:false}}

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Willkommen bei den OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.
",button_title:"Don't care, let's start",position:"top right",url_extension:"",link_button_title:"Let us be careful more information",link_button_url:"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_Data_Protection_Regulation",image_url:null}}

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

By keeping your calendar up to date, you'll feel more in control of your schedule and better prepared to handle whatever comes your way. For example, schedule time to browse for gifts.

++apps.start_page.sub_header="Together, these apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. "

++apps.start_page.apps={todo:{title:"OpenTodos",description:"A to-do list is your personal assistant for staying organized and on top of your daily tasks. As you work through your list and check off completed tasks, you'll feel a satisfying sense of progress that keeps you motivated. Breaking down big projects into smaller, actionable steps makes even the most daunting goals feel achievable. With a calendar, you can plan ahead, set reminders, and allocate time for both work and personal activities. By keeping your calendar up to date, you'll feel more in control of your schedule and better prepared to handle whatever comes your way. For example, schedule time to browse for gifts.
",icon:"/assets/icons/real_icons/calendar.png",enabled:true,position:2,clickable_logo:false},messages:{title:"OpenMessages",description:"An instant messenger is a digital communication tool that allows you to send and receive messages in real time. Instant messengers are designed for convenience and speed, letting you have quick conversations or ongoing discussions without the delays of email or traditional mail. Many services also offer features like message notifications, read receipts, and the ability to see when someone is online or typing. By using an instant messenger, you can keep your conversations organized, respond promptly, and maintain strong connections with the people who matter most to you. Most map services offer features like turn-by-turn navigation, traffic updates, and estimated travel times, making it easier to plan your route and avoid delays. You can also use them to view different types of maps, such as satellite imagery or street views, for a more detailed understanding of your surroundings. With a map service at your fingertips, you'll feel confident finding your way, no matter where you are. For example, look up directions to a store.

These features often include syntax highlighting, auto-completion, and error detection, which help you spot mistakes and write cleaner code. Many code editors also support extensions and integrations, allowing you to customize your workspace and connect with other development tools, such as version control systems or debuggers. With a code editor, you can organize your files, navigate large codebases, and streamline your workflow. By using a code editor tailored to your needs, you'll be able to focus on building great software and bring your ideas to life more efficiently. Shopping online saves you time and effort, allowing you to compare prices, find deals, and place orders at any time that suits you. ++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"欢迎使用 OpenApps！",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.start_page.sub_header="Together, these apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.
"
