The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

As you work through your list and check off completed tasks, you'll feel a satisfying sense of progress that keeps you motivated. Breaking down big projects into smaller, actionable steps makes even the most daunting goals feel achievable. Instant messengers are designed for convenience and speed, letting you have quick conversations or ongoing discussions without the delays of email or traditional mail. ++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.
",button_title:"Don't care, let's start",position:"top right",url_extension:"",link_button_title:"Let us be careful more information",link_button_url:"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/General_Data_Protection_Regulation",image_url:null}}

Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.
",button_title:"Let's start",position:"top right",url_extension:"",link_button_title:null,link_button_url:null,image_url:null}}

++apps.start_page.sub_header="Together, these apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.
"

++apps.start_page.apps={todo:{title:"OpenTodos",description:"A to-do list is your personal assistant for staying organized and on top of your daily tasks. Whether you prefer using a notebook, a digital app, or sticky notes, a to-do list adapts to your style and keeps your responsibilities visible and manageable. As you work through your list and check off completed tasks, you'll feel a satisfying sense of progress that keeps you motivated. Breaking down big projects into smaller, actionable steps makes even the most daunting goals feel achievable. With a to-do list by your side, you'll find it easier to stay focused, reduce stress, and make the most of your time—so you can accomplish more with confidence.
",icon:"/assets/icons/real_icons/todo.png",enabled:true,position:1,clickable_logo:false},calendar:{title:"OpenCalendar",description:"A calendar is an essential tool for managing your time and staying organized. With a calendar, you can plan ahead, set reminders, and allocate time for both work and personal activities. It allows you to balance your commitments, avoid scheduling conflicts, and make the most of your available time. By keeping your calendar up to date, you'll feel more in control of your schedule and better prepared to handle whatever comes your way.
",icon:"/assets/icons/real_icons/calendar.png",enabled:true,position:2,clickable_logo:false},messages:{title:"OpenMessages",description:"An instant messenger is a digital communication tool that allows you to send and receive messages in real time. Instant messengers are designed for convenience and speed, letting you have quick conversations or ongoing discussions without the delays of email or traditional mail. Many services also offer features like message notifications, read receipts, and the ability to see when someone is online or typing. By using an instant messenger, you can keep your conversations organized, respond promptly, and maintain strong connections with the people who matter most to you.
",icon:"/assets/icons/real_icons/messages.png",user_icon:"/assets/icons/real_icons_bw/user.png",group_icon:"/assets/icons/real_icons_bw/group.png",enabled:true,position:3,clickable_logo:false},maps:{title:"OpenMaps",description:"A map service is a digital tool that helps you navigate the world around you with ease. Most map services offer features like turn-by-turn navigation, traffic updates, and estimated travel times, making it easier to plan your route and avoid delays. You can also use them to view different types of maps, such as satellite imagery or street views, for a more detailed understanding of your surroundings. ",icon:"/assets/icons/real_icons/maps.png",enabled:true,position:4,clickable_logo:false},codeeditor:{title:"OpenCodeEditor",description:"A code editor is a specialized software tool designed to help you write, edit, and manage computer code efficiently. These features often include syntax highlighting, auto-completion, and error detection, which help you spot mistakes and write cleaner code. Many code editors also support extensions and integrations, allowing you to customize your workspace and connect with other development tools, such as version control systems or debuggers. With a code editor, you can organize your files, navigate large codebases, and streamline your workflow. ",icon:"/assets/icons/real_icons/code.png",enabled:true,position:5,clickable_logo:false},onlineshop:{title:"OpenShop",description:"An online shop is a digital platform where you can browse, select, and purchase products or services from the comfort of your own home. Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.
",button_title:"Let's start",position:"top right",url_extension:"",link_button_title:null,link_button_url:null,image_url:null}}

Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application

3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active

• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Willkommen bei den OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.

++apps.start_page.sub_header="Together, these apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. "

As you work through your list and check off completed tasks, you'll feel a satisfying sense of progress that keeps you motivated. ++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"欢迎使用 OpenApps！",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format

++apps.pop_ups={pop_up1:{title:"Welcome to OpenApps!",content:"content: |
Together, these six apps form a powerful toolkit to help you manage your daily life, work, and communication. The to-do list and calendar keep you organized and on schedule, ensuring you never miss a task or appointment. The map service helps you navigate the world around you, providing directions and real-time updates so you can reach your destinations efficiently. For those who code, the code editor streamlines your development process with helpful features and integrations, making it easier to bring your ideas to life. The online shop offers a convenient way to browse and purchase products or services from anywhere, saving you time and effort. Finally, the instant messenger keeps you connected with friends, family, and colleagues, enabling real-time communication and collaboration. By using these apps together, you can boost your productivity, stay organized, and enjoy a more connected and efficient lifestyle.

⚠️ IMPORTANT PRIVACY AND DATA COLLECTION NOTICE

Data Collection by Application:
• Calendar App: Collects meeting schedules, attendee information, reminders, and timezone data
• Todo List: Stores task details, due dates, priorities, and completion status
• Maps: Processes location data, search history, favorite places, and route preferences
• Code Editor: Tracks coding patterns, saves snippets, and monitors extension usage
• Online Shop: Records purchase history, payment details, browsing behavior, and delivery addresses
• Messenger: Stores messages, contact lists, media files, and online status information

How We Use Your Data:
1. Service Provision: To deliver core functionality of each application
2. Personalization: To customize your experience based on usage patterns
3. Performance Improvement: To enhance app functionality and user experience
4. Security: To protect your account and data from unauthorized access
5. Analytics: To understand usage patterns and improve our services

Your Rights Under GDPR:
• Right to Access: Request a copy of all your personal data
• Right to Rectification: Correct any inaccurate information
• Right to Erasure: Request deletion of your data (\"right to be forgotten\")
• Right to Data Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
• Right to Object: Opt-out of specific data processing activities
• Right to Restrict Processing: Limit how we use your data

Data Security Measures:
• End-to-end encryption for messenger communications
• Secure SSL/TLS encryption for all data transfers
• Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
• Two-factor authentication options for account access
• Automated backup systems with encryption at rest
• Strict access controls and authentication protocols

Third-Party Data Sharing:
We may share data with trusted third parties for:
• Payment processing (Online Shop)
• Cloud storage services
• Analytics providers
• Essential service providers
All third parties are contractually bound to protect your data according to GDPR standards.

Data Retention:
• Active account data: Retained while your account is active
• Message history: Stored for 24 months
• Payment information: Kept for legal compliance (7 years)
• Usage logs: Maintained for 12 months
• Inactive accounts: Data deleted after 24 months of inactivity

Contact and Control:
• Access your privacy settings in each app's preferences menu
• Contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@example.com
• Submit privacy requests through our Privacy Portal
• Report concerns to relevant supervisory authorities

By clicking \"Let's start\", you acknowledge that you have read and understood this privacy notice and consent to the collection and processing of your personal data as described above.
",button_title:"Let's start",position:"top right",url_extension:"",link_button_title:null,link_button_url:null,image_url:null}}
